* clean:

- Stopped creating database web sessions for anonymous visitors, crawlers, media proxy requests, and other public pages that don't need one. Logged-out language and theme preferences are now kept in a cookie, and anonymous sessions are removed after 24 hours, which keeps the `web_sessions` table from growing with thousands of unused rows.

- Reduced database storage used by enclosure and entry indexes.
- Improved error logging and responses for failed database existence checks and shared-entry lookups.

- Fixed an upgrade failure of migration 127 on databases containing entries whose feed no longer exists.
- Feed-declared language values are now validated before being stored, keeping oversized values and control characters out of the database and the rendered HTML.

- PostgreSQL installations running in FIPS mode are now fully supported by replacing MD5 with SHA-256 for enclosure uniqueness. This change raises the minimum supported PostgreSQL version to **11**.
- Search queries now use PostgreSQL's `websearch_to_tsquery`, allowing quoted phrases, `OR` operators, and negation (`-term`) in search expressions.
- Reduced database work when computing category statistics.
- Improved accessibility by correcting an `aria-labelledby` issue.

* `[FIX]` Treat a backslash as a literal character when scanning standard SQL strings. Placeholders after literals such as `ESCAPE '\'` are now interpolated correctly in SQLite, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, CQL, Presto and Informix, while MySQL, ClickHouse and Doris keep their backslash-escape behavior. PostgreSQL backslashes are only escapes inside `E'...'` strings. Fixes https://github.com/huandu/go-sqlbuilder/issues/251 by @mansur-akhmadi in https://github.com/huandu/go-sqlbuilder/pull/252

* `[FIX]` Support underscores and digits in PostgreSQL dollar-quote tags, and avoid treating dollar signs inside identifiers as quote delimiters by @yuefdev in https://github.com/huandu/go-sqlbuilder/pull/249

## Any RAG 1.3.0

The portable Linux image ships company Graph RAG with policy-controlled publication and signed review. Routine relationships from approved catalog files can publish on sync. Prose, conflicts, and high-impact relationships stay in the review queue until an authorized reviewer makes a decision.

Graph results distinguish unverified model links, reviewed links, and approved declarations. A path flag identifies unverified links anywhere in the supporting path. Existing indexes remain readable.

Any RAG 1.2.0 adds a local review queue for declared relationships in Markdown and text. Run source-first extraction, check each proposed direction and quote, then confirm it for graph search. Open the dashboard with `--review-queue` to see pending proposals. Apply each decision from the terminal. [Setup and commands](https://github.com/skigsy/AnyRAG/blob/5dcf5bdf1a7c61e6bdb3438e789daa35d5cfd2b6/docs/setup.md#opt-into-source-first-extraction)

## Official district spellings now work

Lookups by the current official names used to return nothing, with no error. They now work everywhere a district or division name is passed:

```javascript
upazilaNamesOf("Cumilla")        // the upazilas of Comilla district
getDivisionOfDistrict("Jashore") // "Khulna"
districtsOf("Barishal")          // the districts of Barisal division
searchLocations("Bogura Sadar")  // finds "Bogra Sadar"
```

### Fixed

- **A branch that reaches `END` no longer ends the whole graph.** `StateGraph`
  stopped the run as soon as any branch routed to `END`, so in a fan-out where
  one branch finished early the other branches' remaining nodes never ran and
  the result still reported success. `END` is now a sink: a branch that
  reaches it is done, and the run continues while any other branch has a node
  pending, in parallel and sequential mode alike.
